market_summary: Strong directional moves across the board during NEW_YORK_SESSION: XAUUSD and EURUSD are extended in steep downtrends near lower ATR bands, while US100 and BTCUSD are testing session highs near upper ATR bands. All assets are currently at structural extremes or inside value areas awaiting consolidation, so HOLD is advised across all instruments to avoid chasing end-of-move momentum.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (4032.34) and far below POC (4043.60). CVD is BEARISH (-2.15) with negative slope (-0.33), agreeing with down pressure. SESSION is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is well below VWAP and EMA50, hugging lower ATR band (-2 ATR). RVOL on prior drop showed strong volume confirmation. However, current bar is piercing psychological 4000/Session Low (4000.54) into extended territory after a steep sell-off, raising short-term overextension risk near lower ATR band. Waiting for explicit pullback/rejection.

Price is below VAL (1.1034) and below POC (1.11376). CVD is strongly BEARISH (-15,536) with negative slope (-1154.51). SESSION is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is trading below VWAP (1.11298) and EMA50 (1.11280), extending near the lower ATR band (1.10943). RVOL had yellow spikes earlier on the breakdown. Currently consolidating right near lower ATR band and Session Low (1.10824) without immediate pullbacks to baseline, making new entry risky.

Price is inside Value Area (VAL 1.32661..VAH 1.33251) and slightly above POC (1.32813). CVD is NEUTRAL (-1,562) but with a positive slope (+3309.28) showing short-term bounce momentum. SESSION is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is below VWAP (1.33092) and EMA50 (1.33104), coming off a test of the lower ATR band (1.32765) and Session Low. Inside VA consolidation near POC suggests mean-reversion chop.

Price is breaking out far above VAH (28299.47) and POC (28263.55). CVD is BULLISH (+11.73) with positive slope (+3.42), confirming buy pressure. SESSION is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price holds well above VWAP (28153.31) and EMA50 (28199.53), hugging/crossing upper ATR band (28438.94). Dukascopy tick volume note applied (RVOL spikes rare). Sharp momentum expansion upward towards Session High (28471.88); buying at live price presents high risk of buying the top of forming bar.

Price is above VAH (73920.85) and POC (73650.62). SESSION is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is above VWAP (73703.48) and EMA50 (73751.00), pushing close to upper ATR band (74413.17). However, CVD is slightly BEARISH (-0.06) with zero slope, showing slight divergence against the price push near Session High (74384.10). RVOL volume is normal (no yellow spikes). Resistance overhead at 74254.9 / 74384.1 warrants caution.
